force_definition: Raw OUTCAR forces; fixed bottom 18 Fe excluded only from movable metrics. No ionic convergence or low-force requirement for static labels.
magnetic_policy: Same approved ferromagnetic initialization; any nonpositive Fe local moment is retained as a review flag and withheld from training diagnostics pending review. Positive Fe moments do not establish the global magnetic ground state.
scope: QC may inspect reserved labels for source/physical completeness only. Adaptive coverage and near-pair force analysis consume training labels only. No new DFT, GPU, training, checkpoint change or submission reconciliation.
